notable_absence.finding: This is a pure function reference page (COMPRESS, CONCAT, CONTAINS, INITCAP, LENGTH, LOWER, LPAD, LTRIM, MASK, the MB_ multi-byte family, POS/POSITION family, REPEAT, REPLACE, REVERSE, RPAD, RTRIM, SPLIT, SUBSTR/SUBSTR1, SUFFIXES, TITLE, TOKENS, TRIM, UPPER, URLDECODE, URLENCODE, UNCOMPRESS) with no privilege, role, or credential-type gating anywhere - the only gating content is the version-availability notes captured above.

cross_component_finding: Recurrence of the known docs-issue capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: COMPRESS()/UNCOMPRESS() are each tagged simply 'Couchbase Server 8.0' and seven of the MB_ (multi-byte) string functions are each tagged 'This function is available in clusters using Couchbase Server 7.6 or later' - literal server/-style version strings on a Capella page, despite Capella having no discrete version numbers. Logged as a recurrence, not a new finding. Notably, this recurrence spans TWO different version strings (8.0 and 7.6) on the same page, both absent from the pre-existing version:server-* closed vocabulary (server-6-5, server-6-6-1, server-7-0) - new version concepts minted per the version:server-6-6-1 precedent.
